articles.title: Why CMC/CMCT reads U/G rather than A/C
Keth-seq: Sequencing-based mapping of guanine accessibility using N3-kethoxal modification
articles.summary: Compared with conventional nucleotide-specific probing approaches, Keth-seq introduces a sequencing-compatible Kethoxal modification strategy that enables transcriptome-wide mapping of guanine accessibility and RNA structures at single-nucleotide resolution.

articles.title: EDC probing: In-cell mapping of G and U base-pairing interactions
articles.summary: Compared with DMS, which primarily interrogates adenine and cytosine, EDC expands nucleotide-specific probing to guanine and uracil residues and enables analysis of RNA base-pairing states in living cells.

articles.title: tNET-MaPseq: reading the folding of RNA while it is still attached to the polymerase
PARIS: Psoralen-based mapping of RNA duplex structures and RNA–RNA interactions
articles.summary: Compared with conventional RNA structure probing approaches that mainly report local nucleotide accessibility, PARIS introduces in vivo psoralen crosslinking and proximity ligation to directly capture RNA duplexes, enabling transcriptome-wide identification of RNA–RNA interactions and long-range base-paired structures at nucleotide resolution.

articles.title: SPLASH: Transcriptome-wide mapping of RNA–RNA interactions through psoralen-mediated proximity ligation
articles.summary: Compared with RNA structure probing methods that measure local RNA accessibility or individual RNA conformations, SPLASH uses biotinylated psoralen crosslinking and proximity ligation to directly capture RNA duplex regions, enabling high-resolution identification of both intra- and intermolecular RNA–RNA interactions across the transcriptome.

articles.title: LIGR-seq: Ligation-based RNA–RNA interaction mapping by in vivo crosslinking and proximity ligation
articles.summary: Compared with conventional RNA–RNA interaction mapping approaches, LIGR-seq introduces in vivo psoralen-mediated crosslinking combined with proximity ligation and strand-specific sequencing, enabling transcriptome-wide identification of RNA duplexes and intermolecular RNA–RNA interactions with nucleotide-level resolution in living cells.

articles.title: MARIO: Global mapping of protein-mediated RNA–RNA interactions in living cells
articles.summary: Compared with RNA duplex mapping methods that directly capture base-paired RNA regions, MARIO uses RNA–protein crosslinking and protein-mediated proximity ligation to identify spatially associated RNAs, enabling transcriptome-wide reconstruction of RNA interaction networks and protein-assisted RNA architectures in living cells.

articles.title: RIC-seq: In situ mapping of RNA–RNA spatial interactions and higher-order RNA architecture
articles.summary: Compared with RNA duplex mapping methods that directly capture base-paired regions, RIC-seq uses in situ formaldehyde crosslinking and proximity ligation to preserve protein-mediated RNA spatial contacts, enabling transcriptome-wide mapping of RNA–RNA interactions and higher-order RNA architectures in living cells.

articles.title: COMRADES: Targeted mapping of RNA–RNA interactions and RNA structures in living cells
articles.summary: Compared with transcriptome-wide RNA interaction mapping approaches, COMRADES combines antisense oligonucleotide-guided RNA capture with proximity ligation and deep sequencing, enabling targeted detection of RNA–RNA interactions and structural rearrangements of specific RNA molecules inside living cells.
